about: Generated by firmware/tools/gen_settings_vector.py from the real km_settings.c / km_keymap.c. Do not edit by hand.

v3.about: Settings format version 3 (M6 task P0). cases: commands for the raw model, the answer is what the real writer produced (the version byte shows the version it chose). mutations: patches of the 'v3_everything' blob; blobs: whole blobs; for both, reencoded is what the real reader+writer made of them (null = refused).
